svg.aria-label: The confidence judge on the sealed 349-question gate split: releasing every answer scores 90.5 percent; releasing only the judge's high band scores 91.5 percent with a 95 percent interval from 87.9 to 95.2 that contains the release-everything line, so the gain cannot be told apart from zero.
svg.title: The high band's interval contains the line it has to beat

g.title: accuracy axis, 86 to 96 percent, on the 349 sealed gate questions
release everything: 90.5% — 316 of 349 correct, the sdk_v1 champion's own score with no judge at all
high band only: 91.5% over the 316 answers the judge released, with a 95 percent interval of 87.9 to 95.2 — it spans the release-everything line, so the gain is not significant
the price of the band: 6 of 33 wrong answers caught, and 27 correct answers withheld to do it
the verdict: not adopted as a gate, because AUROC on the sealed split is 0.52 and coverage at the 1 percent error target is zero; the band ships as an advisory caution
